rationale: Independent complete-original-request review confirms three source-stated POI interests: science, nature and outdoor spaces. Family composition, breaks, reduced continuous walking and driving are context or pace/transport preferences. No exclusive focus, named-place requirement or interest quota is stated. The inventory binds the independently reviewed final RequirementSpec.

interests.source_text: We are travelling as a family of two adults and one child. We enjoy science, nature and outdoor spaces. Please favour an itinerary with breaks and less continuous walking. We have rented a car and prefer to drive between sightseeing stops.
